title: How AWS decides: allow or deny
subtitle: Simplified from AWS's evaluation flowchart. Some policies **grant**; others only **limit**. Confusing the two is the whole game.

steps.desc: Every request starts denied (except the root user).
A `Deny` in **any** applicable policy ends it. Nothing overrides it.
Organization filters: they set the maximum, they never grant.
A bucket policy, key policy or trust policy can grant (nuances by principal type).
The identity policy must allow it, **and** the permissions boundary and session policy, if present.
Fall through to the implicit deny.

callout.label: Union vs intersection.
callout.text: Within one account, identity + resource policies are a **union**; identity + boundary or SCP/RCP is an **intersection**. Cross-account, **both** sides must allow: the caller's identity policy and the resource's policy.
